checksum_verification: Downloaded anonymous public Central AAR/POM/module bytes match each published SHA-256 sidecar.

license.scope: Direct SDK metadata/release license only; no recursive native or transitive license audit.

detached_signatures.result: Cryptographically valid GOODSIG and VALIDSIG from GnuPG using a task-isolated keyring.
detached_signatures.signer_trust: Independent certification of the signing-key owner is unverified; validity does not establish owner trust.

adoption_scope: Exact public Bota SDK replacement requested by owner. Application source, identities, non-Bota dependencies and device scope remain unchanged.
acceptance_limits: No phone/device/cloud activity. Package/build qualification does not establish physical or encrypted-upload-v2 acceptance.
